title: Close the browse and playback-start differences the differential tier lists as gaps
description: compat/differences.yaml lists, with kind gap and this task, the fields Jellyfin 12.4 sends that jellyscale leaves out (stream details from ffprobe, flags and counters, UserData.Key), the container names, how Items/Latest groups episodes, the master playlist's bandwidth and codecs, and the oldest-first order of SortBy=PremiereDate descending. Decide for each whether to match Jellyfin or to keep the difference as an improvement, and shrink the list.
acceptanceCriteria: Each entry with task JS-068 in compat/differences.yaml is fixed and removed, or becomes an improvement or non-goal with its reason
test/differential/run.sh passes with the entries removed

GET /Items/Latest honours groupItems as Jellyfin 12.4 does (default true): new episodes of one series are one entry with Jellyfin's count field, limit counts entries after grouping, groupItems=false keeps today's answer; this entry is matched, not kept as an improvement (#234, D-039)
source: first run of the differential tier (JS-064)
notes: Dropped (D-126 and the pivot, D-107): Jellyfin differences go with Jellyfin's API (rule 3).
